cohort: The cohort consisted of 130 term, nulliparous women with prelabor rupture of membranes and cervical dilation of 2 cm or less who underwent induction of labor.
finding: Intravenous oxytocin was associated with faster admission-to-delivery times (16.9 hours) compared to buccal misoprostol (19.9 hours) in term nulliparous patients with prelabor rupture of membranes.
